svg.title: Export priority: what the plant did vs EV-first and BESS-first over the evening peak
svg.desc: Top: stacked export from the EV pile and the home battery, 16:20 to 17:05, against the 30 kW export cap. Bottom: projected home-battery and EV state of charge to 21:00 under EV-first and BESS-first priority.
svg.text: Export priority: what the plant did vs EV-first and BESS-first over the evening peak
12 Oct 2026 AEST · Model Y on the DC pile, Amber V2X `discharge`, 30 kW export cap · top: measured 5-min means · bottom: simple projection
EV alone 25 kW · BESS idle · 5 kW cap unused
If the EV leaves at 18:00 the BESS holds 77 % (EV-first) vs 9 % (BESS-first)
Projection: stores supply 30 kW · BESS 40.3 kWh, 24 kW, floor 10 % · EV 75 kWh, 25 kW (7 kW below 30 %, #21), floor 16 %
